# ReelForge AI

> Content Intelligence & Creative Engineering Platform for Instagram Reels

ReelForge AI is a professional creative-analysis software platform designed to reverse-engineer viral short-form social video content. It replaces guesswork with empirical performance data by analyzing high-performing Instagram Reels and extracting actionable content patterns.

## Target Audience
- Short-form video creators and influencers
- Social media strategists and creative directors
- Marketing agencies managing brand social accounts
- Performance marketers and content production teams

## Core Capabilities
- **Competitor Discovery**: Identifies top-performing accounts in any target niche.
- **Data Ingestion**: Pulls public profile metrics, reel engagement, and post history via automated data pipelines.
- **Content DNA Extraction**: Breaks down viral reels frame-by-frame to analyze hook archetypes, visual pacing, audio choices, retention mechanisms, and call-to-action structures.
- **Data-Backed Script Generation**: Generates production-ready video scripts engineered around proven structural formats using multi-model AI synthesis (Google Gemini, Claude, OpenAI).
- **Export & Workspace**: Exports intelligence reports and scripts in Markdown, PDF, HTML, and JSON formats.

## Key Public Pages
- Homepage: https://reel-forge-ai-psi.vercel.app/
- About Us: https://reel-forge-ai-psi.vercel.app/about
- Pricing & Plans: https://reel-forge-ai-psi.vercel.app/pricing

## Technical Details
- Architecture: Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Authentication: Clerk (Protected Routes: /dashboard, /workspace, /studio, /analytics, /export, /settings)
- Security: HTTPS / TLSv1.3, rate-limited API endpoints, strict content policies
